details.description: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2 (also called Voxtral Mini Transcribe V2) is Mistral AI's batch speech-to-text model, released February 4, 2026 as the successor to the original Voxtral Mini Transcribe. Mistral's docs describe it as an efficient audio input model "pre-trained and optimized for transcription purposes only," and its launch post reports approximately 4% word error rate on the FLEURS benchmark. It adds speaker diarization, context biasing for up to 100 custom words or phrases, and word-level timestamps, and handles recordings up to 3 hours long.
advantages: Mistral reports approximately 4% word error rate on the FLEURS benchmark for this model, per its Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.
Supports speaker diarization, producing transcripts with speaker labels and precise start and end times, per Mistral's Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.
Supports context biasing, letting a caller supply up to 100 words or phrases to guide correct spelling of names, technical terms or domain-specific vocabulary, per Mistral's launch post.
Produces word-level timestamps, enabling subtitle generation, audio search and content alignment, per Mistral's Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.
Mistral states it maintains accuracy in challenging acoustic environments such as factory floors, busy call centers and field recordings, per its launch post.
Mistral's launch post states it outperforms GPT-4o mini Transcribe, Gemini 2.5 Flash, AssemblyAI Universal and Deepgram Nova on accuracy.
disadvantages: Positioned by Mistral for offline, batch transcription; Mistral offers a separate Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime model for live or streaming use cases, per Mistral's documentation and launch post.
Mistral documents strong performance in 13 languages; broader language coverage is not stated, per Mistral's Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.
use_cases: Meeting intelligence and transcription, per Mistral's Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.
Contact center and call center automation, per Mistral's Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.
Media and broadcast subtitling, enabled by word-level timestamps, per Mistral's launch post.
Compliance documentation, including GDPR- and HIPAA-compliant deployments, per Mistral's launch post.

notes: Catalog facts give no max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens or deprecation_date for this model, so there is nothing to reconcile there. Mistral's docs also list the alias voxtral-mini-latest for this same model. The ~4% FLEURS word error rate is reported here in advantages rather than as an evaluations entry, since WER is excluded from the evaluations metric per the brief.
